question.text: A Cat III AIF distributor who provides advisory (fee-based) services to a client must ensure that the client is:

answer.text: Onboarded via the Regular Plan with an additional trail commission
Onboarded only after paying an upfront placement fee to the AIF
Onboarded via either Direct or Regular Plan at the distributor's discretion

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Workbook Chapter 5.11 and SEBI Circular dated April 10, 2023, where a SEBI-registered intermediary charges an investor an advisory or portfolio-management fee, the investor must be onboarded into the AIF only through the Direct Plan. The Regular Plan (which carries distributor commission/trail) is not permitted alongside a separate advisory fee — otherwise the investor would effectively pay twice. The Trap: The Regular-Plan option is wrong because the same intermediary cannot collect both an advisory fee and a distribution trail. The placement-fee option invents a requirement not in the workbook. The 'distributor's discretion' option ignores the SEBI Circular's mandatory Direct-Plan rule for fee-based advisory clients. Note: Changed the keyed answer to 'Direct Plan onboarding only' to match the cited workbook text (the earlier 'both (a) and (b)' wording added a separate-agreement requirement that the cited section does not support) and rewrote the distractors so none of them reference '(a)/(b)', so the item survives answer randomisation.
